integrity.proof: Complete affine weight-two, parity, cylinder-intersection and counting proof in RESULT.md.
integrity.reproducibility_limit: Machine enumerations are finite corroborations, not substitutes for the structural proof.

scientific_limitations: Applies to the particular 16-vertex Clebsch graph, not to all strongly regular graphs or other folded cubes.
The counted objects are unlabelled color partitions on fixed, distinguished vertices; graph automorphism orbits are not quotiented.
The coloring condition applies to open neighborhoods. Publication-priority research is provisional.
title: Two-coordinate cylinder rigidity and the strong odd coloring spectrum of the Clebsch graph
